description: This file contains JavaScript classes and functions for the HelpMeNow feature in vtiger CRM, including JSONP handling, templating, help content retrieval, UI interactions, and translation support.

classes.name: vtiger_help_jsonp
classes.description: Class for handling JSONP requests for cross-domain data fetching.

classes.name: vtiger_help_controller
classes.description: Main controller class for HelpMeNow feature, managing help content retrieval, UI, and translation.

methods.name: apiURL
methods.description: Returns the API URL for help data.

methods.name: runtimeVars
methods.description: Extracts runtime variables like user ID, module, and action from the URL.

methods.name: extractKeyword
methods.description: Generates a help keyword based on current URL context.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the help controller, setting up UI and event handlers.

methods.name: initHandler
methods.description: Creates the help trigger link in the DOM.

methods.name: css
methods.description: Defines CSS styles for help popup (currently commented out).

methods.name: popup
methods.description: Creates and manages the help popup container.

methods.name: popupContainer
methods.description: Returns the container element for help content.

methods.name: closest
methods.description: Finds the closest parent element with a specific class.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Gets or sets data attributes on DOM nodes.

methods.name: pushPage
methods.description: Adds a new help page to the help stack.

methods.name: popPage
methods.description: Removes the last help page from the stack.

methods.name: helpMeNow
methods.description: Fetches help content based on URL and displays it in the popup.

methods.name: helpMeNowNavigate
methods.description: Handles navigation within multi-record help content.

methods.name: recordsUI
methods.description: Generates HTML for multiple help records.

methods.name: recordUI
methods.description: Generates HTML for a single help record.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Uses Google Translate to translate help content.
